comments.author: prsunny
comments.body:
Orchagent tests is expected to be run on simulated tor as there is a step that sets mux status to standby or active via `swssconfig `and this can conflict with the states set by `mux `processes running in the real dualtor setup. I found that the swss standby configs done part of test are overwritten shortly after. So if we have to run orchagent tests on actual dualtor, then we need to rely on the state set by mux container and adjust the tests accordingly. 
@vaibhavhd for viz

> @vaibhavhd do we need this testcases on single ToR devices? What are they checking for for single ToR t0 testbed, and are this verification is needed? Maybe skip them too?

Yes, these skipped testcases are to be executed on single ToR testbed only.

`How do these duator testcase run on single tor testbed?`
We mock the dualtor swss config, and mock the dualtor.

`Why do these dualtor testcase are running only on mocked single ToR?`
For simplicity of testing and verification.
